rules.title: Card Text
rules.text: Pick a number and roll the dice. If the number you choose appears, then take a bunny from the Discard Pile and place it into your hand.

rules.title: Card Text
rules.text: Point to one of your bunnies. Any one opponent's bunny, that has the same color as yours, joins your team.

rules.text: Roll each of the dice up to three times each. If you can finish the rolling with a 2 - 4 - 6 - 8 then you may choose a Carrot.

rules.text: Give this card to any player who has 30 seconds to name a food that starts with the same letter as each of his Carrots or he must give you one of his Special and Very Special cards.

rules.title: Card Text
rules.text:
Roll the Orange die. The code tells you which Carrot you may take (from the pile or from any player).
  • 01 - Q
  • 02 - R
  • 03 - S
  • 04 - T
  • 05 - U
  • 06 - V
  • 07 - W
  • 08 - X
  • 09 - Y
  • 10 - Z
